<details class="showcase-notes">
<summary>Model card: Model Showcase: Model Cards &amp; Results · slide 43</summary>

**Table evidence.** The source chart headed “Four configurations, fastest build per GPU” reports one image per run using the step-distilled checkpoint. Here all three RTX devices use their fastest listed INT8 configuration through ComfyUI and all images are 1024×1024. These are GPU generation times, separate from hosted queueing and network time. [BFL / NVIDIA · 16-step GPU chart](https://bfl.ai/blog/flux-3-image-klein).

**Figure evidence.** Black Forest Labs, generation time by GPU (16-step chart) and Elo versus median API latency. The 0.55 s measurement is generation time on a GB300 at 1024×1024. The 4.54 s BFL API median includes queueing and prompt upsampling. BFL does not identify the server hardware of this API measurement, so the difference cannot be interpreted as measured network overhead. [Primary source](https://bfl.ai/blog/flux-3-image-klein).

**Historical audit.** This is a faithful conversion of the supplied T2I_v1.1.xlsx audit snapshot, checked by its author on 18 October 2026 and refined on 19 October 2026. It is not a fresh verification of these linked sources. “Not disclosed” means absent from the materials covered by that audit, not that the capability cannot exist. Known/Partial/Not disclosed measure disclosure, not model quality or full reproducibility. Prices, endpoints and limits are preserved as dated audit claims.

The existing slide identity is preserved. Open weights does not imply an unrestricted licence. Keep open-checkpoint behavior, auxiliary upsampler behavior and hosted pixel restoration separate. The workbook links architecture implementation detail to a Hugging Face partner article as well as the model card; that is provenance, not a new independent verification.

**Exact scope and category provenance:** sheet `FLUX 3 Image Klein`, identity row 2; `Сводка` row 10. Architecture / Data / Training / Inference / Tools = Known / Partial / Partial / Known / Partial.

**Row provenance and caveats (model-sheet row numbers):**

- Row 2: 5.6B image transformer; both Base and Distilled published; hosted API is flux-3-image-klein.
- Row 6: 5.6B excludes the separate text encoder and prompt upsampler.
- Row 7: Encoder is Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct.
- Row 8: Latent flow model; VAE downsamples 8× per side with 32 channels; 2×2 packing yields one token per 16×16 image pixels.
- Row 9: Diffusers implementation has five per-stream blocks then 28 joint blocks, width 3072.
- Row 10: Eight Qwen3-VL hidden states give 8×2560=20480 features, projected to 3072.
- Row 14: BFL connects Klein to FLUX 3 image/video/audio knowledge; exact Klein mixture is absent.
- Row 15: Training uses detailed whole-scene captions; a separate upsampler expands short edit requests.
- Row 16: Dataset list, example count, synthetic fraction and full-corpus licences are absent.
- Row 20: Undistilled Base and step-distilled Distilled are both published; Distilled backs BFL API.
- Row 21: Launch post names NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 training hardware.
- Row 22: Pretraining filters and targeted safety post-training are described.
- Row 23: Optimizer, base-training steps, loss weights, exact FLOPs and data volume are absent.
- Row 27: Distilled: 16 steps without CFG. Base: 50 steps, CFG 3.5 per BFL.
- Row 28: Up to 4K class; API dimensions 64–6256, at most 16822272 pixels.
- Row 29: Explicit width+height override resolution/aspect ratio; otherwise editing inherits first-reference size.
- Row 30: Up to ten references; seed 0–4294967295; API steps 1–16, default 16.
- Row 31: API outputs JPEG by default or PNG.
- Row 32: BF16 weights plus FP8/NVFP4; NVIDIA/ComfyUI also provide an INT8 build.
- Row 33: Less than 0.6 s at 1 MP on GB300/NVFP4 is vendor GPU time, not end-to-end API latency.
- Row 34: API USD per result: 1K .009, 2K .014, 4K .036, same for T2I and editing.
- Row 38: Single checkpoint handles T2I, single-reference editing and multi-reference composition.
- Row 39: Separate 9B flux-3-image-klein-pup is called by reference CLI but not automatically by Diffusers.
- Row 40: Boxes influence position/size, are not hard masks, and edits can affect pixels outside them.
- Row 41: Pixel restoration is a hosted API claim, not guaranteed behavior of the open weights alone.
- Row 42: No grounding field in the reviewed Klein API; full Image grounding must not be transferred.
- Row 43: Fine-tuning recommended on Base; LoRA can be used with Distilled; Diffusers/AI Toolkit recipes exist.
- Row 44: ComfyUI, Diffusers, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang Diffusion and vLLM-Omni are listed.
- Row 45: FLUX Kommunity License v1.0 permits qualifying commercial generation/output use below US$5M revenue including affiliates, subject to terms; this is not blanket permission for commercial fine-tuning or redistribution.

<details class="showcase-notes">
<summary>Results: Model Showcase: Model Cards &amp; Results · slide 44</summary>

Published results checked 21 October 2026. These are sourced examples and reported measurements; no models were run for this deck.



A vendor output collage spans photographic, illustrated and typographic work.



- **T2I preference gain: +91 Elo **. Relative to FLUX.2 [klein] 9B in BFL internal comparison; not a cross-leaderboard score. Attribution: vendor_internal_evaluation. [Source](https://bfl.ai/blog/flux-3-image-klein).

- **Editing preference gain: +70 Elo **. Same BFL comparison against FLUX.2 [klein] 9B. Attribution: vendor_internal_evaluation. [Source](https://bfl.ai/blog/flux-3-image-klein).

- **Median API latency: 4.54 s T2I / 7.18 s edit **. 1 MP, request to finished output, queue included; BFL timed on its own servers, competitors from clients. Attribution: vendor_latency_measurement. [Source](https://bfl.ai/blog/flux-3-image-klein).



**Example provenance and limitations.**

The October 15 launch explicitly captions this collage as FLUX 3 Image Klein outputs; checkpoint subtype is unspecified.

Examples do not distinguish Base from distilled. The API serves distilled with prompt upsampling and pixel restoration.

Vendor evaluations are not independent reproductions.

[Published media/source](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/2gpum2i6/production/eada5ee663c5523ab6d43c858baaf037867d324e-2000x1344.webp): FLUX 3 Image Klein: official output collage.. Rights: Public BFL showcase; page footer reserves rights. No separate demo-image licence identified. Attribute Black Forest Labs; model-weight licences are distinct.
